verdict.rationale: Gusto's own announcement says developers and power users can connect through Gusto's MCP server [gusto-docs-12]. It also lets owners connect Gusto to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to query payroll, prep payroll and generate reports, with approval of every change [gusto-docs-10, gusto-docs-11, gusto-docs-13]. A Multi-Client MCP lets firms work across selected clients [gusto-docs-22]. The evidence comes only from press-release claims, without technical docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: first-party MCP setup and tool reference documentation, details on auth and scope of exposed tools, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
